blurb: Guests receive thorough training, take a scenic flight above turquoise waters, and perform a tandem skydive with expert instructors. The experience includes freefall and parachute descent with breathtaking views of the Florida Keys. The operation has over 30 years of experience and a strong safety record.
extraNote: Free to reschedule and cancel any time before plane takes off · No-show without cancellation may incur $50 charge · Open 7 days a week, 365 days a year
